newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apex PC rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apex PC rated buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Reid Dabney said he initiated coverage of Apex PC Solutions Inc with a buy rating and a target price range of $13 to $15 a share.
-- He said the price target is based on 20 times the 1998 earnings estimate of $0.65 a share. He estimated 1997 earnings at $0.50 a share.
-- Apex makes and markets stand-alone switching systems and other products for the client/server computing market.
